title: Argentina fans have heart problems after matches – level 1
paragraphs: Watching football can be dangerous for the heart. In Argentina, many fans are very stressed during the 2026 World Cup games.

The matches are very exciting. Doctors see a big rise in heart problems. In one area, 35 people have heart attacks. It is much more than usual. Many people go to the hospital. They do not feel well. They want their team to win.
Doctors say that big stress is bad for people who already have sick hearts. They tell fans to stay calm. If they feel bad during a game, they should ask for help.
